prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a friend who will live on your desktop."]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Learn the basic desktop controls to hide, summon, and talk to your companion anytime.", "Click desktop tray icon to hide or summon pet", "Right-click pet for interaction menu", "Got It!"]
2: ["Give Your New Pet a Name", "Make it official by naming your companion before completing the certificate.", "Pet Name", "Confirm Name"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Engine...", "Checking screen resolution and positioning your pet safely on your desktop.", "Initializing pet desktop renderer...", "Desktop Display Check: Active"]
4: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Signing in automatically syncs and restores your existing pets and progress."]
5: ["Select Your Pet Experience", "Choose between adopting a ready-made companion or creating a custom pet."]
6: ["Welcome Your Companion Home!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.", "Start Interacting"]
7: ["Compatible with all multi-monitor desktop configurations and taskbars."]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Click to seal your official adoption certificate.", "Official Adoption Seal Verified"]
9: ["Photo Format Diagnostic", "We checked your image for desktop pet animation compatibility.", "Image Quality: Verified", "Proceed to Adoption"]
